method.train_terms: Supplied dictionaries; original term/POS mappings preserved
method.validation_terms: Supplied entries when available; otherwise exact surface AND Penn POS pairs already in the same supplied aspect dictionary; no new words, forms or aspect transfers
method.normalization: Unicode casefold + spaCy rule lemmatizer, forced VERB/NOUN from supplied POS; NN uses Number=Sing
method.reference_domain: Validation lemmas only, separately for actions and objects
method.candidate_rule: Any normalized action OR object outside its validation pool
method.empty_rule: Empty categories are flagged, never counted as OOD; both empty => REVIEW
method.invalid_pos_rule: Preserve and flag unsupported POS; exclude from lemma membership; REVIEW unless other terms are OOD
method.semantic_scope: Lexical vocabulary coverage, not a semantic OOD or rewrite-feasibility guarantee
limitations: Dictionaries cover Train IDs only; restricted Val vocabulary cannot measure Val words outside the supplied dictionaries.
POS and rule-based lemmas can be wrong or ambiguous; raw forms remain in every row.
Individual terms do not encode phrasal verbs, action-object relations, or temporal alignment.
No automatic replacement or LLM rewrite has been performed.
method.output_order: Original caption order; pools alphabetical; frequency descending
